title: Ego2Sim2Humanoid: Agentic Real-to-Sim for Learning Loco-Manipulation VLAs without Robot Demonstrations

release_status.value: Official repository advertises code coming soon. Full implementation, training data and weights were not verified.

evidence_boundaries: Input includes RGB-D, tracked head trajectory and visible 3D hand poses.
The missing lower-body and out-of-view motion is synthesized for the robot.
Two G1 tasks, 20 trials per task; no target-task real robot demonstrations for fine-tuning.
Contact planning comparison and EgoHumanoid retargeting comparison are not real-world VLA success comparisons.
EgoHumanoid-V2 full baseline reports metrics over 6 completed held-out clips.
Object physical parameters are estimated from priors; deformable and heavy object transfer is unverified.
